Symptom: every order confirmation email is sent twice. The team is sure it's the retry middleware, since logs show it firing. Reproduce: place any order in staging; two identical emails arrive. Observed in staging and production since Monday. Changed recently: the email module was moved into a plugin loaded by both the API and the jobs package.

Logs for one order:
```
12:00:03.114 retry: attempt 2 for POST /payments (timeout)
12:00:05.302 email: sent order-confirmation to a@x.com
12:00:05.302 email: sent order-confirmation to a@x.com
```
Retry middleware: retries only POST /payments, 2s backoff.

```js
// plugins/email.js
export function register(bus) {
  bus.on('order.created', sendConfirmation)
}
// api/index.js and jobs/index.js both call: register(sharedBus)
```

Symptom: API memory grows ~40MB per hour until the pod is OOM-killed. Everyone blames the new LRU cache library added two weeks ago. Reproduce: run the load test for 2 hours. Observed in production. Changed recently: the LRU cache (max 1000 entries) and a per-request audit hook.

Heap snapshot diff after 1h: +310k `Listener` objects retained by `EventEmitter` 'audit'; LRU cache: 1000 entries, 2MB, flat.
Node warns: `MaxListenersExceededWarning: 11 audit listeners added`.

```js
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  auditBus.on('audit', e => log(req.id, e))
  next()
})
```

items.name: real cause: listener added per request, never removed
rules out the cache with evidence
client-side check is not a control
